verdict.rationale: Sardine documents adjustable fuzzy-match thresholds for screening, so analysts can trade off true positives against false-positive alerts (configurable name matching). Its sanctions screening routes matches for analyst review with explainable scores, but nothing shows how alias or transliteration matches are surfaced or inspected. missing for 10: explicit alias/transliteration matching and match-detail inspection, deeper docs on name-matching configuration options, independent or hands-on corroboration.
